sentence: This project builds a brain-inspired deep learning model that tries to work out human emotions in natural images.
This project builds a degree program in quantum information science and engineering that draws on physics, chemistry, mathematics and computer science.
This project studies how flow matching can translate data from one form to another and generate content without losing the intended information.
This project tries to find out which organic compounds make soil repel water after wildfires and how heating changes them.
This project uses geophysical imaging to study how electrical signals in soils along coastal interfaces change with soil moisture and organic matter.
This project builds a framework that combines information from many different data sources to make better predictions.
This project designs a small chip that tries to detect lung cancer signals in blood serum quickly and accurately.
This project builds a data science program that teaches machine learning and data engineering and studies which teaching methods work.
This project builds a tool that uses large language models to pull enzyme information from papers and databases and lets users ask questions in natural language.
This project measures how long a free neutron lives and how often carbon and helium nuclei fuse to make oxygen inside massive stars.
This project builds tools and data sets that let computers turn many languages, videos and images into one shared meaning format.
This project builds a certificate program in artificial intelligence and robotics for science and business programs.
This project develops ways to make atomically precise clusters of semiconductors using cation exchange reactions.
This project tries to find out whether making artificial intelligence models larger is enough for scientific discovery or whether something more is needed.
This project builds a framework that helps computers make safe, reliable and explainable decisions from network data.
This project acquires an instrument that measures carbon, nitrogen and sulfur isotopes in small amounts of organic matter.
This project builds methods that help machines learn by trial and error when they can see only part of what is happening.
This project studies how groups of decision-makers learn together and when their learning settles into a stable outcome.
This project builds a cloud-based platform that helps communities plan and carry out prescribed burns more safely.
This project builds software that predicts how proteins bind to DNA or RNA.
